Billboard.GroupModeHint.zh: 平面保留成员各自模式；立牌将局部内容作为一块牌放置。
Billboard.GroupModeHint.en: Surface preserves member modes; Billboard places the local content as one card.

Billboard.InsideCard.zh: 高度与接地点仍生效，随组合统一透视。
Billboard.InsideCard.en: Elevation and ground anchors still apply; perspective follows the whole group.

Billboard.UngroupFirstFlat.zh: 请先将组合切回平面模式，再解除组合。
Billboard.UngroupFirstFlat.en: Switch the group to Surface before ungrouping.

Billboard.UnsafeMove.zh: 无法在目标层级安全保持当前外观，未移动任何图层。
Billboard.UnsafeMove.en: The destination cannot safely preserve the current appearance. No layers were moved.

Billboard.AnchorHint.zh: X / Y 表示画布平面上的地面锚点；离地高度使用逻辑长度。
Billboard.AnchorHint.en: X / Y locate the ground anchor on the canvas plane; elevation uses logical units.

Billboard.ConversionFailed.zh: 当前位置无法转换放置方式，请调整图层位置或画布透视。
Billboard.ConversionFailed.en: Placement cannot be converted here. Adjust the layer position or canvas perspective.

Billboard.InvalidDepth.zh: 当前角度无法确定立牌落点。
Billboard.InvalidDepth.en: Cannot determine a billboard anchor at this angle.

Billboard.InvalidLogicalPlacement.zh: 当前位置与尺寸无法形成有效立牌，请调整位置或尺寸。
Billboard.InvalidLogicalPlacement.en: No safe billboard placement for this position and size. Adjust either and retry.

Billboard.ChooseDepth.zh: 点击选择深度，然后绘制
Billboard.ChooseDepth.en: Click to choose a depth, then draw

Billboard.DrawDirect.zh: 点击按逻辑尺寸居中放置，拖动确定轮廓；底边中点接地
Billboard.DrawDirect.en: Click for centered logical size, or drag the outline; the bottom center touches ground

Billboard.PlaceDirect.zh: 点击居中放置立牌；逻辑尺寸不变，视觉近大远小
Billboard.PlaceDirect.en: Click to center the billboard; logical size stays fixed and perspective sets its visible size

Billboard.FixedDepthWorkflow.zh: 立牌：先固定等深线（高级）
Billboard.FixedDepthWorkflow.en: Billboards: fix a depth line first (advanced)

Billboard.PendingGround.zh: 请将图层框底部移到地平线安全区域内
Billboard.PendingGround.en: Move the frame bottom into the safe ground area
